name: Nairobi Securities Exchange Plc
source: Nairobi Securities Exchange Plc audited group results for the year ended 31 December 2025; H1 2026 column from the unaudited financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026. | CRON 2026-11-21: H1 2026 Total income corrected from 1,210,292 to 1,210,292,000 and Data income from 75,221 to 75,221,000, both 1000x low because the filing prints in Kshs thousands and these two rows were carried unconverted while every other H1 row in the file was already at units. Proof: 1,210,292,000 less operating expenses 309,748,000 equals the stored operating profit 900,544,000, and the stored net margin 60.88 percent and operating margin 74.41 percent are both computed on 1,210,292,000. The Revenue row was already correct at 1,210,292,000 and was not changed. | CRON 2026-11-24: Operating Profit (EBIT) and Operating Expenses filled for FY2022 and FY2023 from the audited consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, NSE Plc integrated annual report 2023 page 74, printed Sh 000 scaled by 1,000 to units. FY2023 printed: total income 662,321; total expenses 596,038; profit before ECL and fair value movements 66,283; provision for expected credit losses 5,145; unrealised loss on bond mark to market (9,673); share of loss of associate (19,429); profit before income tax 42,326; tax expense (23,922); profit after tax 18,404. FY2022 printed: total income 642,764; total expenses 550,989; profit before ECL and fair value movements 91,775; provision for ECL (62); bond mark to market (7,370); share of loss of associate (46,544); profit before income tax 37,799; tax expense (24,075); profit after tax 13,724. Ties: 662,321 less 596,038 equals 66,283 and 642,764 less 550,989 equals 91,775, the printed operating line of each year; 66,283 plus 5,145 less 9,673 less 19,429 equals the printed 42,326 and 91,775 less 62 less 7,370 less 46,544 equals the printed 37,799, so the operating line bridges to the stored Profit Before Tax exactly. Operating Expenses is the printed total expenses line stored negative, and Revenue is the printed total income line, matching the FY2025 and FY2024 columns already in this file.
source_note: Kshs'000 x1000 to absolute KES. Top line is total income (levies, data, interest and other income), not sales revenue. 2024 expense line items foot to 672,575 but the printed total is 673,267 (issuer 692,000 gap); printed total retained. | Operating Profit (EBIT) FY2025 read from NSE-PLC-Audited-Financial-Statements-For-The-Year-Ended-31-December-2025-1.pdf | Operating Profit (EBIT) FY2024 read from NSE-PLC-Audited-Financial-Statements-For-The-Year-Ended-31-December-2025-1.pdf | The row labelled Operating Expenses held [null, 322,114] (the issuer other operating expenses, 2024 only) and the panel alias matched it, so the real Total expenses row never rendered. That row is deleted and the Total expenses row is relabelled so the printed FY2025 total 741,453 and its FY2024 comparative 673,267 both render. Five year series and the H1 2026 column read from the printed statements: ar_2021.pdf p91, ar_2022.pdf p77, ar_2023.pdf p74, ar_2024.pdf p79, ar_2025.pdf p105, and the unaudited interim statement for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (page 1). Rows carried back for every year are Total income, Profit before income tax, Income tax expense and Profit after tax; the expense lines below that are printed for FY2024 and FY2025 only, so their older cells are blank rather than estimated. Dividend history: the interim statement records that the Board resolved not to declare an interim dividend for the six months to 30 June 2026. Five year series read from the printed statements: ar_2021.pdf p91, ar_2022.pdf p77, ar_2023.pdf p74, ar_2024.pdf p79, ar_2025.pdf p105. Lines carried back for every year are Revenue, Profit Before Tax, Income Tax and Net Profit; the expense detail below that is printed for FY2024 and FY2025 only, so older cells stay blank rather than estimated. EPS, return on equity, return on assets and net margin for FY2021 to FY2023 are computed from the printed profit and the equity, assets and shares in issue stated in the same reports; they are arithmetic on printed figures, not a reported line.
